description: Exact path-based exceptions for ops/scripts/validate_memory_egress_boundary.py. Every entry names why the path may spell a forbidden token and an expiry; an expired entry is a finding. Nothing here authorizes provider egress — since stage C11 every remaining entry is a negative check, a scanner/allowlist self-reference, a protected operator-owned file, or a secret-inventory row, never a code path that calls a provider (CURSOR_GOVERNANCE_MEMORY_CONTROL_PLANE_REALIGNMENT_BUILD_PLAN §8).
mode_note: enforce (stage C11+): any unlisted or expired finding fails the validator and tests/ops/memory/test_egress_boundary.py. The legacy provider client, env plane, shadow reader, distiller and their tests were deleted at C11; ops/graphiti/graphiti_memory_client.py is a tombstone that spells no provider token.
